issues: (1) Integrity is fine. The diff only changes two LR schedule hyperparameters: WARMDOWN_RATIO goes from 0.5 to 0.7 and FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05. It doesn't touch the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines, the prepare.py import or the evaluation call.

(2) No bugs found. Both values are in a sensible range, and with WARMUP_RATIO = 0.0 a 0.7 warmdown doesn't overlap the warmup. Ending the LR at 5% of its starting value instead of 0 is a valid choice.
(3) No claims contradict the numbers. The candidate scored 1.0517 against an incumbent mean of 1.0528, a gain of 0.0011. That rests on one candidate run, and the incumbent mean on two.

I couldn't recompute z independently because the individual incumbent values and their spread weren't given. The reported z = 0.178 implies a noise scale of about 0.0011 / 0.178 ≈ 0.0062 bpb. That fits the gain being within run-to-run noise, so the provisional reject holds.
If you want to test this further, replicate the candidate before drawing a conclusion, since a single run can't separate a ~0.001 gain from noise.
